never: mint a key, or match a record on a customer name or a phone number, once an upstream id exists
make a second job for an enquiry that already has an open one
treat a write with no external id, or a chat or connector confirmation, as a write
send a quote, an invoice or a chase without a release naming a person or a rule
move a hop only while a chat session is open
stays_with_person: every exception, by the owner named for its stage
the release, or the rule that stands in for it
deciding two enquiries are the same job when the number does not say so
anything the four standards it binds keep with a person

provider_block.job: one record survives from the call to the chase

checks.title: Every downstream step takes its id from the system of record, never from a name or a phone number
One job per enquiry: a repeat call or a second door attaches to the open job
A write that comes back without an external id is treated as not written
The quote carries the job id, the invoice carries the quote or job id, and the chase reads the invoice id off the live ledger
A chat or connector confirmation is not a write and not a release
Every hop starts from a named event, and none waits for a chat session
An exception names its owner, travels with the record, and the next step does not pass it
